verdict.rationale: Typesense's docs have a 'Search UI Components' section (typesense-docs-31), and its live demo sites (songs search, geosearch) show working search interfaces. That is only a nav-level mention, though, with nothing on which libraries exist, which frameworks they target, or what widgets they ship. A 2020 community thread (typesense-comm-7) asked about InstantSearch compatibility, which shows demand but neither confirms nor refutes support. missing for 10: named official UI library/adapter details, documented widgets for search box, results, facets and pagination, framework coverage (React/Vue/Angular/mobile), hands-on or independent corroboration.
